messages:
marta.s: Heads-up — we need a short sync on the audit event taxonomy before the next rollout. Noticed divergent names coming from infra and platform. @raj.k @ben.j can you weigh in?
raj.k: Yep, saw that. infra emitted `session.create` while platform used `user.session.created`. chaos.
ben.j: Agreed messy. Propose we standardize to `actor.subject.action` dotted format, e.g., `user.session.create`. keeps verbs present-tense and short.
olivia.p: Quick Q: which of these are customer-visible? we need a flag so we can redact internal-only events from docs / UI.
marta.s: Good call. Add a top-level boolean `customer_visible` and a `visibility_notes` free text for edge cases.
raj.k: Also KMS integration: current telemetry includes `kms_key` string. we should pick canonical field name — `kms_key_id` vs `encryption_key_id`? any downstream contracts?
ben.j: prefer `kms_key_id` (stable id, no key material). downstream analytics already expect `_id` suffix, simpler for joins.
marta.s: RBAC change events: we have multiple event shapes floating: `role.grant`, `rbac.assign_role`, `user.role_added`. I'd like canonical verbs: `role.assign` and `role.revoke`. target should be `role.name` + `role.id`. keep subject=actor who triggered the change.
olivia.p: For public docs we should map `role.assign` -> human readable label. also ensure we do not leak permission lists in the event payload. only `role.id` / `role.name`.
raj.k: Agree. Also we should add `actor_auth_method` (e.g., `sso`, `api_key`, `service_account`) for incident triage. That helps correlate if a change came from automation.
ben.j: Example event shape (proposal):
```json
{
  "event_name": "role.assign",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-10T15:12:34Z",
  "actor": {"id": "u_1234", "type": "user"},
  "target": {"id": "r_admin", "type": "role", "name": "admin"},
  "customer_visible": "false",
  "kms_key_id": "proj-a-key-7",
  "actor_auth_method": "sso",
  "notes": "canary rollout - auto-assigned by infra",
  "schema_version": "v1"
}
```
raj.k: that looks good. tiny nit: `customer_visible` should be boolean (true/false) not string. also include `event_id` (uuid) for dedup and trace.
marta.s: fixed in my head :) We'll make `event_id` required.
olivia.p: For validation, I suggest we add a lightweight JSON schema and a lint step in the event emitter CI so teams catch missing required fields before deploy.
ben.j: +1. Also add an evaluator that flags any event where `customer_visible=true` and payload contains `actor.email` or `target.user_list`. we must prevent accidental PII leaks.
audit-bot: New schema draft created: /docs/audit/schemas/event-taxonomy-v1.json (generated by audit tool) :thumbsup:
marta.s: Next steps: 1) raj to land canonical field names + event_id requirement in infra emitters (due EOD Thu). 2) ben to add JSON schema + CI lint for platform emitters (due Mon). 3) olivia to draft customer-visible doc guidance and PII checklist (due Mon). We'll reconvene after implementation. Thanks all :rocket:
